The climate in Tirana

Tirana is about 110 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 32°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 2°C. Around 1360 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 192 mm). The highest temperature in Tirana in 2015–2024 was 40°C (25 July 2023) and the lowest −9°C (8 January 2017).

Best time to visit Tirana

The most pleasant weather in Tirana is usually in May, September and October: average highs are between 22°C and 27°C, with up to 14 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
